headline: 马克·保莱塔获任美国国家首都规划委员会主席
summary: 特朗普8月26日任命保莱塔为NCPC不分地区委员并指定其担任主席；机构于8月31日发布公告。

sources.title: President Trump Appoints Mark Paoletta National Capital Planning Commission Chairman
sources.excerpt: On August 26, 2026 President Donald Trump appointed Mark Paoletta as the at-large Presidential appointee to the National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) and designated him to serve as Commission Chairman.
